设计意图： Mutates the parent's directional price-impact efficiency mechanism with a monotonic bounded compression before slower EWMA smoothing. The compression preserves the sign and relative ordering of ordinary observations while limiting the influence of extreme candle-volume shocks that likely contributed to weak payoff robustness and elevated churn. 因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-(EWMA_30[impact_efficiency / (1 + |impact_efficiency|)], where impact_efficiency=((close-open)/open)/(volume/rolling_20_median(volume)))
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

输入字段

字段含义说明

volume成交量基础行情字段

算子

算子含义
rolling_20_medianrolling_20_median(x) → 20 日滚动中位数

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_mediann 期滚动中位数

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 body_return：(close - open) / open
  2. 计算 typical_volume：volume.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).median()
  3. 计算 normalized_volume：volume / typical_volume
  4. 计算 impact_efficiency：body_return / normalized_volume
  5. 计算 bounded_impact：impact_efficiency / (1.0 + impact_efficiency.abs())
  6. 计算 factor：bounded_impact.ewm(span=30, min_periods=18, adjust=False).mean()
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_bounded_directional_price_impact_per_volume(df): """Bounded ">class="kw">and smoothed directional intraday price impact per normalized volume.""" df_copy = df.copy() body_return = (df_copy["close"] - df_copy["open"]) / df_copy["open"].replace(0.0, np.nan) typical_volume = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=10).median() normalized_volume = df_copy["volume"] / typical_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan) impact_efficiency = body_return / normalized_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan) bounded_impact = impact_efficiency / (1.0 + impact_efficiency.abs()) factor = bounded_impact.ewm(span=30, min_periods=18, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() df_copy["factor_bounded_directional_price_impact_per_volume"] = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_bounded_directional_price_impact_per_volume"]
